May raise the outer-city quota of a settlement by one beyond the research limit (the more already won the lower the chance).
May raise the level cap of the chosen building by one (the higher the cap the lower the chance).
May add one building slot to an outer city (the more slots it has the lower the chance).
May raise how many cities you may found by one (the more already won the lower the chance; never past 20 in all).
May raise how many resource fortresses you may found by one (the more already won the lower the chance).
May raise how many military fortresses you may found by one (the more already won the lower the chance).

heroes: Compiled by imperial order, the sum of military learning: a hero gains 10,000 experience.

An imperial call for worthy men and women: your hero limit rises by one, for good.
